data.narrative: The student implemented a production-grade observability stack comprising structured JSON logging with mandatory correlation IDs, Prometheus metric instrumentation via prom-client, and actionable Prometheus alert rules with runbook links. They demonstrated strong systems thinking by enforcing bounded label cardinality to prevent metric memory explosion and ensuring that unhandled server exceptions emit both 500 status metrics and structured error logs with matching request_ids.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained minimal, reproducible container architecture with zero unnecessary dependencies, ensuring scraping endpoint /metrics works reliably within Docker environment.
dimension_scores.evidence: Docker build succeeds cleanly, Prometheus scrape endpoint exposed on standard service port without requiring privileged daemon bindings.

dimension_scores.observation: Ensured metrics and logs are emitted predictably across all middleware chains, maintaining zero drift across local and deployed environments.
dimension_scores.evidence: RequestIdMiddleware and HttpExceptionFilter intercept requests and responses consistently, emitting duration_ms and status code metrics.

dimension_scores.observation: Comprehensive coverage across logs, metrics, and alerts: structured JSON logs with timestamp, level, message, service_name, request_id; Prometheus counter http_requests_total and latency histogram; alert rules with summary, description, and runbook.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified GET /metrics exposes populated buckets and total counts; request-id header returned and embedded in JSON log stream.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified and mitigated the three core observability failure modes: silent error swallowing, metric cardinality explosions from unbounded dimensions, and disconnected log trails caused by missing request IDs.
dimension_scores.evidence: HttpExceptionFilter logs stack traces with correlation IDs on 5xx; prom-client labels are strictly bounded to method, path, status.

dimension_scores.observation: Structured metrics and logging operate with non-blocking execution inside middleware finish events, preventing logging delays from degrading application throughput.
dimension_scores.evidence: res.on('finish') callback defers metric recording and logging until after the client response is flushed.

dimension_scores.observation: Created alerts.yml containing complete Prometheus alert configurations with precise expressions, thresholds, for durations, severity labels, human-readable explanations, and runbook links.
dimension_scores.evidence: alerts.yml rules: HighErrorRate (>5% over 5m), HighLatency (p95 > 2s over 5m), and ServiceDown (up == 0 for 1m).

strengths: Zero cardinality leakage: adhered to strictly bounded Prometheus label dimensions (method, path, status)
Correlated logging: ensured every request and exception carries an identical request_id across all log entries
Production-ready alerts: wrote actionable alerting rules with human-readable descriptions and direct runbook references
data.recommendation: In Module 05, extend this failure-first telemetry to monitor downstream dependency latency and circuit breaker state changes.
